correctness.rationale: Conditioning on a prescribed isolated K2 removes its two vertices and forces the other m−1 edges to be uniform in the Q=C(n−2,2) remaining potential edges. The conditional triangle mean C(n−2,3)(m−1)_3/(Q)_3 minus the unconditional mean yields the stated exact covariance and factorization. The positive prefactor times A_n(m−3)−B_n m changes sign at m*=n/2+1−(n+5)/(3n²−6n−1), strictly between ceil(n/2) and its successor. In G(n,p) conditioning on K2 excludes both endpoints and yields strictly negative −C(n,2)(n−2)^2p^4(1−p)^{2n−4}. Sparse scale m=⌊cn/2⌋ gives c³(c−1)e^(−2c)/2.
residual_risks: No conclusion of stochastic dependence, mechanism, or higher moments from covariance sign.
